note: Title and year most likely identify Maria Alice Rosa Ribeiro’s book. The author field instead combines Maria de Fátima Bento Ribeiro’s “Entrando na zona, entrando no mundo” with a reference to Marcos A. Lopes; retain uncertainty.

id: W:rosenstone|historia nos filmes os filmes na historia
original_title: History on Film/Film on History
note: Portuguese translation of the 2006 Pearson Longman book. Neither Visions of the Past nor Revisioning History is the same work; the original is absent from the candidates.

original_title: Immaginazione sociale
container: Enciclopedia Einaudi, vol. 7: Imitazione–Istituzioni (Torino: Einaudi, 1979), pp. 54–92; Portuguese translation: “Imaginação social”, Enciclopédia Einaudi, vol. 5: Anthropos–Homem (Lisboa: Imprensa Nacional–Casa da Moeda, 1985), pp. 296–332.
note: An encyclopaedia entry, not the whole book Les imaginaires sociaux (w-288737). Original entry title, year and pagination confirmed in the publisher’s bibliographical reference; no DOI confirmed.

original_title: A produção capitalista do espaço
note: Portuguese selection of seven essays plus an interview from Spaces of Capital (2001), not a complete translation. Do not match the larger collection w-120695. ISBN confirmed in the university library’s acquisitions catalogue.

original_title: Afrique noire: histoire et civilisations
note: África Negra is the Portuguese title of this multivolume work. The citation omits the volume and subtitle; the graph’s collective-title record covers the work.

original_title: Pensées de M. Pascal sur la religion et sur quelques autres sujets
note: A modern edition of the posthumous Pensées. Select the 1670 French work, rather than later editions, selections or collections containing additional writings.

original_title: The Organization Man
note: William H. Whyte, Jr.’s 1956 Simon and Schuster book. No candidates supplied; original-edition LCCN confirmed in the library MARC record.

original_title: Encoding/decoding
container: Stuart Hall, Dorothy Hobson, Andrew Lowe and Paul Willis, eds., Culture, Media, Language: Working Papers in Cultural Studies, 1972–79 (London: Hutchinson, 1980).
note: A chapter within w-1088442, not the whole collection. The DOI is confirmed in Routledge’s deposited metadata for the 2003 digital edition. The chapter revises the earlier 1973 television-discourse paper.

original_title: Small Is Beautiful: A Study of Economics as if People Mattered
note: By E. F. (Ernst Friedrich, also called Fritz) Schumacher. The catalogue confirms the 1973 London original, published by Blond and Briggs. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Gender and Power: Society, the Person and Sexual Politics
note: R. W. Connell’s 1987 Polity book, now catalogued by the publisher under Raewyn Connell. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Ritual: Perspectives and Dimensions
note: The 1997 Oxford University Press book, distinct from Ritual Theory, Ritual Practice (w-1188824, 1992). Original-edition LCCN confirmed in the catalogue.

original_title: The Exhibitionary Complex
note: The original journal article, subsequently collected in The Birth of the Museum (w-252188). The containing book is not a work-level match; no DOI confirmed for the original article.

original_title: The Spectator
note: Addison and Richard Steele’s essay periodical, first issued in 1711–1712 and revived in 1714, subsequently collected as books. Kind book denotes the collected work within the permitted schema; the confirmed OCLC identifies Donald F. Bond’s 1965 collected edition.

original_title: The Power of Gifts: Gift Exchange in Early Modern England
note: Heal’s 2014 Oxford University Press monograph. Hospitality in Early Modern England is a different book; no candidate matches.

id: W:gascoigne|cambridge in the age of the enlightenment
original_title: Cambridge in the Age of the Enlightenment: Science, Religion and Politics from the Restoration to the French Revolution
note: Gascoigne’s Cambridge University Press book, first published in 1989. LCCN confirmed in the publisher’s original-edition cataloguing data; none of the supplied candidates matches.

original_title: Industry and Empire: An Economic History of Britain since 1750
note: The cited shortened subtitle identifies the 1968 book also published as Industry and Empire: The Making of Modern English Society, 1750 to the Present Day. Choose the English work, not its German translation w-242120.

original_title: Accounting for Slavery: Masters and Management
note: Caitlin Rosenthal’s 2018 Harvard University Press book. Original-edition LCCN confirmed in the publisher-distributed front matter. No candidates supplied.
